parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.summary: Return a list of all External Submittals.
get.description: Return a list of all External Submittals for the specified project. External Submittals are copies of submittals from connected upstream projects, accessible via Connections Manager.

schema.description: A Connected Submittal is a read-only downstream projection of an upstream submittal shared across a connected-project boundary. The list endpoint returns an array of these objects under `data` (minimal fields); the show endpoint returns a single object under `data` with the additional extended-only fields (`has_revisions`, `connected_distributed_submittals`, `connected_submittal_connection_detail`, `linked_drawings`, `cover_sheet`, `project_connection`).

id.description: Unique identifier of the connected submittal. Use as the {id} path parameter for GET /connected_submittals/{id}, GET /connected_submittals/{id}/revisions, and PATCH /connected_submittals/{id}/linked_local_submittals.

number.description: Display number of the connected submittal. When spec-section numbering is enabled for the project, this is the spec-section-prefixed number.

title.description: Title of the connected submittal. May be null if the upstream submittal has no title.

description.description: Free-text description of the connected submittal. May be null.

status.description: Downstream projection status of the connected submittal, derived from the upstream source. This is not a submittal log status.

translated_status.description: Localized, human-readable label for the downstream `status`, suitable for display.

revision.description: Revision label of the connected submittal. May be null.

current_revision.description: Whether this record is the current revision of the connected submittal.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the connected submittal projection was created, in ISO 8601 format.

last_updated_at.description: Timestamp when the connected submittal projection was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the connected submittal was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the record is not deleted.

for_record_only.description: Whether the submittal is marked for record only (no workflow response required).

private.description: Whether the submittal is private and visible only to permitted users.

buffer_time.description: Buffer time, in days, configured for the submittal schedule. Null when not set.

lead_time.description: Lead time, in days, for the submittal. Null when not set.

prepare_time.description: Preparation time, in days, for the submittal. Null when not set.

design_team_review_time.description: Design team review time, in days. Null when not set.

internal_review_time.description: Internal review time, in days. Null when not set.

revision_source_connected_submittal_id.description: ID of the connected submittal that is the source revision for this record. Null when this record is the original revision.

connection_status.description: Whether the connected submittal's upstream project connection is currently syncing (`connected`) or not (`disconnected`).

actual_delivery_date.description: Actual delivery date, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not set.

confirmed_delivery_date.description: Confirmed delivery date, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not set.

distributed_at.description: Date the submittal was distributed, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not distributed.

due_date.description: Due date for the submittal, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not set.

issue_date.description: Issue date for the submittal, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not set.

received_date.description: Date the submittal was received, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not set.

required_on_site_date.description: Required-on-site date for the submittal, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not set.

submit_by.description: Submit-by date for the submittal, rendered at noon in the project time zone. Null when not set.

type.description: Submittal type of the connected submittal. Null when no type is assigned.

translated_name.description: Localized, human-readable name of the submittal type.

responsible_contractor.description: Vendor responsible for the connected submittal. Null when none is assigned.

id.description: Identifier of the responsible contractor vendor.

name.description: Name of the responsible contractor vendor.

created_by.description: Contact who created the upstream submittal.

login_information_id.description: Identifier of the associated login information (user), when the contact maps to a Procore user. Null otherwise.

vendor_name.description: Name of the vendor the contact belongs to. Null when the contact has no vendor.

received_from.description: Contact the submittal was received from. Null when not set.

login_information_id.description: Identifier of the associated login information (user), when the contact maps to a Procore user. Null otherwise.

vendor_name.description: Name of the vendor the contact belongs to. Null when the contact has no vendor.

submittal_manager.description: Contact assigned as the submittal manager.

login_information_id.description: Identifier of the associated login information (user), when the contact maps to a Procore user. Null otherwise.

vendor_name.description: Name of the vendor the contact belongs to. Null when the contact has no vendor.

specification_section.description: Specification section associated with the connected submittal. Null when none is assigned.

label.description: Display label combining the section number and description.

linked_local_submittals.description: Local submittals linked to this connected submittal.

revision.description: Revision label of the local submittal.

status.description: Current status of the local submittal. Null when the submittal has no status.

has_revisions.description: Whether the connected submittal has additional revisions. Present only on the show (single-record) response.

connected_submittal_connection_detail.description: Details about the upstream project connection for this connected submittal. Present only on the show (single-record) response.

id.description: Identifier of the connection detail record.

status.description: Whether the upstream connection is currently connected or disconnected.

upstream_company_name.description: Name of the upstream company that owns the source submittal.

linked_drawings.description: Drawings linked to the connected submittal upstream. Present only on the show (single-record) response.

items.description: A linked drawing with its file attachment.

id.description: Identifier of the linked drawing record.

attachment.description: File attachment metadata for the linked drawing (identifier, name, and viewable/download URL).

cover_sheet.description: Most recent generated cover sheet PDF export for the connected submittal, with its file attachment. Null when no export exists. Present only on the show (single-record) response.

id.description: Identifier of the cover sheet PDF export record.

attachment.description: File attachment metadata for the cover sheet PDF (identifier, name, and viewable/download URL).

project_connection.description: Upstream project connection identifiers and names for the connected submittal. Null when there is no active connection. Present only on the show (single-record) response.

upstream_project_name.description: Name of the upstream project that owns the source submittal.

upstream_company_name.description: Name of the upstream company that owns the source submittal.
